scope: All ten original full bodies actually read in this restored session; current action routes are source snapshots, not new empirical evidence or a full reproof.

items.retained_positive_result: The original research agenda includes recursive utility, constrained actor/critic control, endogenous preferences and strategic interaction. The report explicitly says those ambitions need not be abandoned.
critical_original_findings: The specified joint performance-plus-squared-residual loss has a wrong minimizer even with exact terminal conditions: the terminal-preserving perturbation lowers the loss by -epsilon/2+7 epsilon^2/3. A stationary version minimizes a nonzero Hamiltonian.
Vanishing population L2 residual and exact boundary values do not select the correct viscosity solution; the supplied exit-time sequence tends to the wrong sign.

Merton constants, Epstein–Zin marginal utility, NDU state viability/cardinal normalization, temporal-self deviations and unilateral game gradients were individually defective. The DDPG figure was an illustrative perturbation, not independently trained data.
Single-bank stochastic-trace squaring changes the objective by a variance term; constant-step Adam does not satisfy the invoked two-timescale theorem. The additive capital example was separable.
items.r121_specific_treatment: The current bounded marginal fitting problem, exact primal/dual audit and original-policy gate are explicitly different objects, with no restored global-minimizer or optimizer-convergence claim. The original correctness appendix preserves the exact counterexamples and fixes, foundations retain model/boundary/gradient assumptions, and the new risk marginal is derived from original Bellman primitives. Strong conventional structure remains available.
items.remaining_requirement: The old constructed figures and original false-loss experiments are not regenerated by R121. The NDU, Epstein–Zin infinite-horizon, temporal-self and dynamic-game applications retain their own well-posedness, observation, equilibrium, benchmark and execution obligations.

items.retained_positive_result: R2 genuinely repaired block objectives, boundary/domain treatment, the viscosity route, finite-state error accounts and provenance; the original report reproduced 29 computations and eight tests.
critical_original_findings: The reported portfolios and LQ studies used scalar homothetic or exact matrix calculations; the generic multilayer core was tested only at the derivative-routing level.
The finite NDU reference chose all three truncation bounds and changed materially under action-set expansion. It did not establish a continuous-action optimum.

Uniform residual, action-gap, boundary and discretization premises were not generically computed. Dynamic Cournot was a diagnostic rather than a dynamic neural equilibrium. Raw arrays were not yet durably complete.
items.r121_specific_treatment: The completed later multilayer experiments are retained rather than credited for the first time to R121. Current work defines a concrete root-risk critic, pays its original-value and marginal information, certifies its finite fitting problem and uses a total original-law action service. The new complete package retains all original report bodies and route maps, not only summaries.
items.remaining_requirement: The original exact-structure regressions remain correctness checks, not neural scaling evidence. A generic high-dimensional continuous-domain certification method, justified NDU action boundaries and a continuous game error account are not completed by the new two-state investment study.

items.retained_positive_result: R6 really trained multilayer tanh actors/critics without reference labels in stopped consumption. All three NBO and three direct-HJB fits passed the one-dimensional full-domain interval thresholds; all joint-loss ablations failed. Finite NDU/game and coupled-capital programs and failures were materialized.
critical_original_findings: The strong full-domain certificate used a special one-state problem, closed-form action maximization and a small network; direct HJB was comparable.
All three NDU NBO policies failed the declared 0.1 finite-model regret target while direct Bellman passed; same-version reruns changed exact NBO values across CPU/BLAS platforms.
Two of three dimension-20 NBO runs failed local diagnostics, and sampled residuals coexisted with large critic-versus-simulated-payoff discrepancies due to coverage and discretization uncertainties.
Finite Cournot best-response success was not neural continuous-game evidence; total certified accuracy and actor advantage remained unestablished.
items.r121_specific_treatment: The original scalar certificate is preserved as an achieved result with arithmetic-contract and dimensional scope. Current work pays exact risk integration and candidate certification, independently evaluates first and final policies, and treats clocks separately from statistical confidence. The new full-state finite fallback is a property of the stated investment service, not an extension of the scalar diffusion certificate.
items.remaining_requirement: Cross-platform training robustness, multidimensional continuous-domain verification, NDU policy competitiveness and high-dimensional domain/discretization error require their own study. R121 does not turn those old failures into successes.

items.retained_positive_result: The actual R7 evidence repaired finite NDU performance, trained and checked neural finite Cournot policies, improved high-dimensional path coverage and independently replayed the scalar cover in mpmath.iv. Raw NDU actors already passed before small guard corrections.
critical_original_findings: The reviewed source/evidence pair still carried the R6 manuscript roots, so evidence completion was not an integrated R7 article.
Training computed all-action or all-joint-action Bellman values and exact labels before the actor. Small guard frequency did not remove that paid exhaustive oracle.
Guarded NDU was about 21% slower than direct fitting and about 304 times slower than classical backward induction on its finite economy.

NDU and Cournot continuous-state/action/time transfer fields remained null; the high-dimensional study had no continuous-time bias or optimal-value bound. Later gated/Chebyshev protocols were unexecuted post-result development.
items.r121_specific_treatment: R121 keeps complete source, manuscript, evidence and publication identities distinct. It discloses its paid original-risk probes and grants all of them to conventional/value controls. Raw first proposals and completed services remain separate; later protocols or frozen episodes are not promoted to completed evidence.
items.remaining_requirement: This study does not recreate the R7 continuous-economy bridges, change its exhaustive supervision into non-enumerative learning, or complete its formerly unexecuted comparator protocol. Those facts retain their historical source identities.

items.retained_positive_result: R8 supplied an integrated manuscript, a genuinely non-enumerative continuous-action actor, separate raw/search/direct controls, a budget-safe full action cover and stronger projection/classical comparisons. Independent stress checks supported the enclosure without claiming a formal proof.
critical_original_findings: Local search changed essentially every actor action, actor-free search was faster and had a better mean bound, and all nine hybrid policies failed the uniform 0.1 target.
The complete-action verifier used 40.96 million boxes and about 1625 seconds; it saturated all time levels and retained millions of unresolved leaves.
Frozen-policy refinement had full-grid reference advantages rising to 1.5662 and 2.1234 despite stable center values. Continuous-state/time/stopping transfer remained uncomputed.

Chebyshev, gated regression, classical dynamic programming and direct search were stronger where verified; no single high-dimensional experiment combined generic training, matched strong controls and domain certification.
items.r121_specific_treatment: The new study evaluates every raw first proposal independently even when the final service repairs it. Fit, proposal, refusal, refinement and complete work are separate records. The original feasible capacity is an economic primitive, and the current marginal/path account concerns that unchanged original recursive objective. Full-state comparisons and adverse cases are retained.
items.remaining_requirement: R8's off-grid NDU failures, action-cover complexity and missing continuous-diffusion bridge are not resolved by new investment finite states or by a globally valid but potentially loose marginal modulus. A stronger neural contribution still needs actual economic and computational evidence.

items.retained_positive_result: R10 trained generic actors/critics in dimensions 10, 20 and 50 and proved a substantive model-specific continuous-time bound against all adapted competitors using logarithmic curvature, synchronous coupling, spectral verification and an analytical schedule.
critical_original_findings: The bound held for every policy in the architectural tube before training and gave the untrained schedule a strictly tighter guarantee.
The actor beat the schedule in the paired Euler comparison only in dimension 10, lost in 20/50, and cost about 48–50 times more in training plus certification and 30–34 times more at deployment.

Fixed-update greedy critics, tube regularization and different learned derivative quality were confounded. Three conditional training objects and unknown Euler bias did not establish robust method superiority.
The theorem did not cover the retained recursive-utility/NDU/game agenda or supply a calibrated economic conclusion.
items.r121_specific_treatment: The current response separates safety from learned improvement. R120's policy-specific action and independent-optimum evidence is retained, while R121 changes critic acquisition/fitting and requires the proposal and complete policy to be independently evaluated. The new finite fitting certificate changes with the stored coefficients; it is not itself an economic success.
items.remaining_requirement: R10's continuous-capital performance envelope and negative schedule comparison remain intact. They are not a generic NBO convergence theorem, and this revision does not claim to have rerun or calibrated that capital experiment.

items.retained_positive_result: R11 genuinely made its continuous-time post-training certificate policy-specific and supplied ten-seed high-dimensional NBO, direct-policy and affine comparisons, explicit innovation-history implementation, transfer/clipping error and finite-family inference.
critical_original_findings: Direct policy used the same actor and achieved essentially the same certified schedule gain at lower cost; the small NBO-minus-DPO difference was not directly certified.
Training closed only 2.8–6.3% of the analytical schedule regret bound; safe improvement did not imply an accurate HJB solution.
Most large initial-state stresses lost positive lower endpoints. The policy observed innovations through a stronger information structure than ordinary state feedback.
Nine pre-simulation integer-array failures were transparently repaired but were not a clean single end-to-end source execution; radius rows rescaled frozen policies instead of refitting.
items.r121_specific_treatment: New state/model/source barriers and the actual observation map remain explicit. The current comparison uses the same original information and objective for all arms, independent same-state contrasts and a separately declared population family. Clocks do not create new independent policy samples. Original failures and rescaling semantics remain historical facts.
items.remaining_requirement: The innovation-observation capital theorem is not silently transferred to state-only or noisy control, nor are its small gains recast as near-optimality. Calibrated state populations and method-level training uncertainty still require their own evidence.

items.retained_positive_result: The R12 design introduced the correct direct paired estimand, costate/action-loss mechanism, finite initial-state population, exact-history observation theorem and independent scalar nonlinear HJB reference. Its available smoke was explicitly development evidence.
critical_original_findings: At the reviewed snapshot the final experiment, tables, evidence branches and integrated manuscript were absent; a workflow intention and one-seed 32-path smoke were not executed final evidence.
The complete publication gate was red from an inherited README preservation mismatch and unresolved typography, despite 19 passing R12 tests.
A 20-second wall clock was not a stable matched-accuracy benchmark. The costate conditional projection did not establish actual critic accuracy or economic value.
The observation theorem required exact continuous noiseless history, known coefficients/drift integral and private randomization; the scalar reference did not validate high-dimensional policies.
items.r121_specific_treatment: The present initial response explicitly marks all new outcomes and freeze identities pending and retains the already completed R120 article as baseline. R14/R15's later actual executions are credited separately rather than backdated to the incomplete R12 head. Current reports, source hashes, pending protocols and final evidence retain distinct roles.
items.remaining_requirement: R12's exact-history theorem is not a practical discrete-observation algorithm, and its missing-at-review results cannot be called present in that original snapshot. The current two-state study does not complete its high-dimensional accuracy or calibrated application requirements.

items.retained_positive_result: R14 was an actually complete source-bound publication with 90 fitted policies, direct common-path comparisons, fixed-work/raw-costate and mechanism panels, operational continuous-time policy certificates, finite sensing and a stronger scalar reference.
critical_original_findings: All 120 primary and 42 fixed-work direct intervals contained zero. Raw was cheaper and had larger sample means in every dimension/checkpoint cell; critic costate MSE and critic-greedy Hamiltonian gap were worse in all six panels.
Mechanism quantities were measured on training-design states, not the required candidate occupation law; rollout bias and global derivative errors were not controlled.
The high-dimensional regret bounds were 14–21 times the mean improvements, while method-level training uncertainty and a single complete matched-accuracy work frontier remained absent.
The strong verification framework was candidate-neutral; the title's learned Bellman contribution and the broad stylized economic agenda were not established by those positives.
items.r121_specific_treatment: R121 targets the critic mechanism through actually paid original-risk marginal labels, exact finite-box optimization bounds, off-design feature-range transport and direct independent economic evaluation. Equal information, full conventional controls and the whole failed/rejected proposal census are part of the design. None of these planned actions changes the old inconclusive intervals or Raw comparisons.
items.remaining_requirement: The current finite-cell theorem must not be described as an executed tight occupation-law or high-dimensional welfare account. R121 still needs actual results before any critic contribution, cost frontier or adoption is claimed.

items.retained_positive_result: R15 executed all 128 cells of a declared sixteen-stream finite method distribution, included failed target attainment in total work, added a neural-HJB control, executed an occupation-law mechanism and finite-observation study, and retained scalar classical superiority.
critical_original_findings: The original dimension-50 NBO/HJB result was prospective; the dimension-10 sign appeared only after a sharper deterministic transfer was developed and applied to the same observations. A valid reanalysis is not a new prospective confirmation.

NBO/Raw and NBO/DPO intervals were unresolved beyond the practical-equivalence band. Raw was cheaper at the dimension-50 target; the operational critic mechanism had negative sufficient welfare bounds and very wide risk intervals.
The HJB result applied to one expensive residual-fitting and online-search implementation in a pilot-selected high-volatility design, not all HJB methods.

High-dimensional results remained safe improvement with broad regret bounds; the scalar classical policies were better and faster, and the finite stream population did not imply broad algorithmic or economic robustness.
items.r121_specific_treatment: The current design freezes its own theorem, algorithms, information budgets, models, sample and reporting rules before corresponding outcomes. It does not replace post-freeze analytical reanalysis with invented preregistration. The new marginal critic uses the same paid information and features as value/conventional competitors, and both raw proposals and delivered policies receive original-model evaluation. Full costs and inactive/negative mechanisms remain reportable.
items.remaining_requirement: R15's Raw/DPO comparison, declared-HJB scope, pilot-selected calibration, subsequent transfer refinement and separate observation/volatility studies remain distinct. R121 does not claim a general neural-specific separation, a replication of the R15 refined transfer, or a calibrated capital welfare gain.
